text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — our new Next.js starter (next-starter-v2) is failing parity tests in the eval harness. Looks like the JS SDK doesn't reattempt auth refresh on 401 the same way Python does. Repro steps below.

Alex Chen: Repro (local): 1) npx create-next-app using next-starter-v2 2) yarn dev, hit /api/generate 3) SDK call returns 401 and no retry, eval harness marks it as a regression.

Alex Chen: Minimal snippet from pages/api/generate.js:```js
const res = await redwood.generate({ prompt });
// res is 401 error here, no automatic refresh triggered
```

Maya Patel: saw this in CI too :eyes: failing on macOS runner with identical stacktrace. pasted tail of logs: "AuthError: token_expired -> 401 -> abort"

Samir Gupta: also hitting this in the LlamaIndex sample where the embedding call sometimes returns 401 on warmup. JS path gives up, python path refreshes and retries. Could be middleware ordering?

Elena Rosa: quick theory — our JS SDK's auth interceptor is async but doesn't pause the request pipeline correctly when refresh is inflight. Simple fix is to queue pending requests during refresh.

Elena Rosa: pseudo-fix:```js
// in sdk/httpClient.js
if (resp.status === 401 && !opts._retrying) {
  await auth.refreshToken();
  opts._retrying = true;
  return httpClient.request(opts);
}
```

devex-bot: CI failure recorded: https://ci.internal.redwood/gh/infra/next-starter-v2/12 -> tests/eval/parity -> 2412345710

Jared Lim: can someone paste repro with env? I tried locally but couldn't trigger unless token was expired. If we have a small repro script that'll help root cause.

Alex Chen: yes — token expiry can be forced via REDWOOD_TEST_EXPIRE_MS=1000 then run the sequence: start server, wait 2s, call endpoint. I'll add a tiny repro script to the repo in a follow-up PR.

Maya Patel: temporary workaround for anyone blocked: set REDWOOD_SDK_ASSUME_RETRY=true in .env — this makes the client automatically retry on any 401 once. Not ideal but unblocks eval runs.

Samir Gupta: noted that the LlamaIndex example also had a kv-cache header mismatch that caused a 403 on retry; watch out for non-idempotent calls. We should only auto-retry safe endpoints.

Elena Rosa: good call — we'll gate by method: only retry GET/PUT/OPTIONS/POST when flagged idempotent via opts.idempotent === true.

Jared Lim: leaving a comment on a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-starter-v2/pull/48 — includes unit test for queued-refresh behavior and an eval harness fixture.

Alex Chen: created PR with repro + tests and the auth-queue change. requesting review from @Elena and @Samir. Will also add docs note in starter README about auth env for local dev.

Maya Patel: LGTM once tests pass. can we also add a short blurb to the eval harness docs about forcing token rotations for CI to catch regressions?

Alex Chen: added eval docs note in the PR and pinned a flaky test to skip on windows runner.

devex-bot: PR merged by Alex Chen at 2412345718 — next-starter-v2@main updated. :shipit:

Samir Gupta: verified with local run, parity harness now passes for the JS path. Thanks! :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: huge thanks everyone — will follow up with a tiny migration note for existing users (env var + how to opt-in/out).
